body:
STORY-1706 resumed and pushed.
- PR B: aida#2834, head 0373952fc2, trailer (STORY-1706). It is gate-protected, so it needs an independent STRICT approve and then the operator merges (C4).
- PR A: aida-relay#97, head f3ef691, trailer (Refs STORY-1706).
NEEDS RULING: amendments A1 (resume argv; implemented in both PRs, C1 holds literally) and A2 (orphan AIDA_RELAY_RUN process check; implemented). Both are on the spec comments. Known limit: a restart needs the run's spec known from relay.status ("spec unknown" otherwise); left unchanged pending your ruling.
Gates: targeted tests 218/0 (story_1706, 1699, 1700, fleet_lanes, mandate*) on the tree merged with main. One story_1700 test changed: relay-restart is no longer a bogus scope, so it now uses relay-kill. Ineligible crashed lanes no longer write an extra skip row; they keep today's advisor routing.
BLOCKED gate: make check-ci-fast passed every gate up to "TUI seam guard", then: "cargo: error: refusing build: target filesystem has 11.8G (2.5%) free, below hard floor (15G); run 'cargo reap --apply' or set AIDA_CARGO_DISK_MIN_GIB=0 to override". /home/joe/ai/aida/target (sdd1) is 98% full; cargo reap finds 0 dirs to reclaim. make test-touched is blocked the same way. Not bypassed; CI will run both.
Relay shell suites: 21 pass, story1706 included. Six never started (bug2152, bug2153, story106, story109, story23, story80) because each waits for a cargo build slot; CI's shell job covers them.
subject: STORY-1706 PRs open: aida#2834 @0373952fc2, aida-relay#97 @f3ef691 (A1/A2 need ruling; disk floor)
